ideaDescription: A web tool for small retail teams that automates inventory alerts reducing stockouts and manual spreadsheet work.
explanation: Technical feasibility is strong, but market viability is below 65. Validate demand and willingness to pay before building further.
technicalSummary: Low-novelty web PoC with clear spreadsheet-ingest scope, highly accessible resources for a typical web stack, and measurable stockout/manual-work outcomes.
marketSummary: Credible retail pain from stockouts and spreadsheet work, but thin willingness-to-pay evidence, unspecified reach, and weak differentiation versus POS/inventory alerts.
insights: When the idea gives no price, spend, or comparable products, rate willingness-to-pay conservatively (memory-bank learning).
